title: Inteff III
summary: King of Thebes in Egypt's Dynasty 11, in whose reign a famine is recorded.
description: King of Thebes in Egypt's Dynasty 11, in whose reign a famine is recorded. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (1816 to 1808 BC). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, section "5. Isaac’s Famine: ~1816 BC"
reign.note: From CFAH's placement of Dynasty 11 and the Turin Canon.

reign.note: Row "EKL #12 Chnubus = Intef III" of Table 15 (Egypt (Eratosthenes King List, EKL)).
